summary: Independent verification of the two deployment-build fixes (RC1 kkiapay removal, RC2 Node heap bump on export:web) and zero-regression check of the app. All fix artifacts confirmed on disk, pip dependency graph now resolves cleanly (DRYRUN_EXIT:0), verify-package-json gate still exits 0, backend + admin auth healthy on preview URL, and the full 7-test regression suite passes. Frontend loads landing page (RealAICoach hero), admin can sign in via UI, dashboard 'Welcome back, Admin' renders with session_token cookie and /api/auth/me is_admin=true. Note: /tmp/pip_clean2.log and /tmp/yarn_build_cold.log from the main agent's prior run were gone after a pod restart, so I re-ran an equivalent (faster) pip dry-run in a fresh venv to independently prove the resolver succeeds.

integration_issues.issue: First navigation to https://full-stack-migrate-1.preview.emergentagent.com hit a transient Cloudflare 502 for ~1 minute after (pod-uptime ~3m) — Metro was still warming from the on-disk cache. Cleared by itself; second attempt returned HTTP 200. Pre-existing platform behavior, NOT a regression from the two code changes under test.

Landing page 'newsletter-email-input' with type='email' sits above the fold and is picked up first by generic input[type=email] selectors. The actual login form uses placeholder='you@example.com' — test scripts should target that. Not a functional bug, just a testing note carried from iter1/iter2.

Backend regression: /api/health 200, admin cookie login 200, /api/auth/me returns is_admin=true with 3 roles (admin/premium/user), /api/openapi.json admin-gated (401 anon, 200 admin). No fresh Traceback in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log — the single historical Traceback at line 40 is the previously-known secret-vault startup enforcement error from a prior boot; current boot logged after that has no Traceback and no ImportError. Zero kkiapay-related import failures.
Non-blocking pre-existing warnings persist unchanged from iter1/iter2 (Require-cycles AppShell↔GlobalNavBar, textShadow deprecation, expo_manual watchdog ERROR spam) — carry forward, not regressions.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Deployment build fixes (RC1 kkiapay removal + RC2 NODE_OPTIONS 5632 MB heap on export:web) are verified green — the two changes are safe and the app has zero regression on backend (7/7 pytest) or frontend (admin UI login → dashboard). The prior /tmp/*.log build artifacts may be wiped by pod restarts; the fastest independent re-verification is: (a) `grep -n kkiapay /app/backend/requirements.txt` (must return nothing) + `python3 -m venv /tmp/vv && /tmp/vv/bin/pip install --dry-run -r /app/backend/requirements.txt` (must end DRYRUN_EXIT:0), and (b) `grep -n max-old-space-size /app/frontend/package.json` (must appear on start/expo/export:web) + `node /app/frontend/scripts/verify-package-json.js` (must exit 0). DO NOT run a full `yarn build` unless the frontend supervisor service is first stopped — it needs the RAM. LIVE payment keys still hot in backend/.env — keep read-only.
rca of the issue: Cloud Build failed for two independent reasons captured by main agent: (RC1) requirements.txt could not be installed cleanly in a fresh container because kkiapay==0.0.6 transitively pinned requests==2.22.0 while other deps require requests==2.33.0 → pip ResolutionImpossible. kkiapay was dead code (only a case-insensitive string label check in receipt_generator.py, no import). Fix: dropped the line from requirements.txt. (RC2) `yarn build` invoked expo export without the Node heap bump; on cold containers with no Metro cache the ~3000-module bundle OOMs at V8's default 2 GB. Fix: prefixed the export invocation with NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=5632 and `node --max-old-space-size=5632`, mirroring the repo's own 'start'/'expo' script convention. Both artifacts verified independently in this iteration.
